notes.title: Bit Animation Editor - 1.6.0 - Unreal 5
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5zEqkd6g8ms;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Export options to support Unreal 5 and an extensive open source Unreal 5 package to convert projects to Native Unreal 5 Flipbook animation and sprites.
This is powered by Editor scripts in python masking material and Blueprint Actors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38334836/bc4794d2a6b45ec490fe30ae5f18d16e11311e15.gif[/img]

This patch also include a large free set asset-packs, bringing the total to 870 sprites and animations.

JSON export for faster iteration cycles in Game Engines.
AS well as minor bug fixes and improvements, see patch notes below.

[b]This is a Windows Only Version, low adoption and cumbersome C++ steps to deploy to multiple platforms. The Source code is still cross-platform compatible but built with Visual Studio.[/b]

The open source unity package supports new version but might require some fiddling around with the current weaks LTS builds. Download the repository and include it as a local package.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=df2YSK-vwZc]Here[/url] is an example of Bit animations running on a Nintendo Switch.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rRRd-G35h_o]Here[/url] is some example gameplay video of Bit running together with FMOD and event driven audio.
[url=https://github.com/MorgondagDev/Bit-Animation-Editor-UE5]Open Source Unreal 5 Plugin[/url]
[url=https://github.com/MorgondagDev/Bit-Animation-Editor-Unity-Importer]Open Source Unity Plugin[/url]


[h3]Bit Animation Editor - 1.6.0 - Patch notes[/h3]
[list]
[*]  New Asset packs with a total of 870 sprites and animations.
[*]  Unreal 5 Support & Unreal 5 Exporter.
[*]  Open source Unreal 5 Project with examples.
[*]  Export project file as JSON and JSON Array.
[*]  Fixed link to documentation.
[*]  Fixed some corrupt sprites that prevented exporting.
[*]  Listed Tweening support for Unity & Unreal 5.
[*] Set some default values for export to prevent crashes in Unity and Unreal 5.
[*] Fixed a big that displaced scene assets out of the scene when using the sidebar menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Bit Animation Editor - 1.5.0 - Randomizer
notes.content:
This patch comes with a new feature-set to randomize the asset configurations and a new free asset-pack "Turner" with 31 animated sprite. AKA you can add stuff randomly.

Randomization in its full chaotic glory with uniform distribution. You can choose to add a asset to the scene with all of its configurations like mirroring, size, positions, pattern and rotation shuffled. A new tab is available that supports a range of randomized operations to manipulate the assets in the scene.

These randomized properties follow a lose set of rules of different outcome, its not procedurally generated patterns that looks good, this is true random. And one of the milestone in order to have a more controlled procedural generation option in the future.

Use it to create unpredictable designs that only the robotic gods would have thought off.

Bit Animation Editor - 1.5.0 - Patch notes
New Asset pack "Turner" with 31 sprites.
New core randomizer functionality with uniform distribution.
Added a new "Add randomized to the library assets"
Added a new "Randomzie" tab on selected scene entities.
Added Randomize states to history-states.
Fixed a bug with selecting sprite animations selector that could result in corrupt data on file write.
Update Steam SDK.

notes.title: Bit Animation Editor - 1.4.0 - Linux
notes.content:
Bit now works on Linux hurry!
We mainly focus on support Ubuntu 20 LTS but other distributions might work as well.
Let us know how it work on your snowflake OS :-p
A new small asset-pack as well as a Linux animations is available to celebrate this addition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38334836/437dc6da284d8a0dd7c0b218ccf5e047705a8a2d.png[/img]

Today we use the tool to create art and and game assets.
We got a feature by [url=https://www.deviantart.com/morgondagdev/art/The-Three-Machines-852473132]Deviant Art [/url].

And some of the bigger painting is seeing traction on [url=https://www.reddit.com/user/morgondag/?sort=top]Reddit[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/morgondagdev]Twitter [/url]and other social media.
It feels great to be able to have a tool to create unique art with.

[b]Please use the Steam forum for feature requests, questions, or bug reports we actively monitor that.[/b]

[h3]Bit Animation Editor - 1.4.0 - Patch Notes[/h3]

[b]🌟Features & 👾Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*][b]Linux Support[/b]
Bit now works on Linux.

[*][b]New free asset pack pack "Linux"[/b]
22 new assets to play around with.

[*][b]New example animation "Linux"[/b]
A celebration animation for Linux.

[*][b]New palette "Linux".[/b]
See the palettes folder in the install folder for all available free palettes.

[*][b]Mac Big Sur[/b]
Some minor library updates for Big Sur.

[*][b]Menu header[/b]
Increased size for windows and Linux.

[*][b]Consolidated Linux & Mac code-base[/b]
Large code base cleanup to support more OS.

[*][b]Import asset Mac[/b]
Fixed a large import bug that could crash the app when importing PNGs on mac.

[*][b]Mac file-picker[/b]
Rewrote file-system dialog for Mac to remove some bugs when canceling an export.

Rewrote how frames and key-frame intervals are calculate to prevent crashed on large exports.

Thank you ❤️

notes.title: Bit Animation Editor - v1.3.0 - New assets and bug-fixes
notes.content:
Halloween is here which we celebrate with a 10% discount and a new shiny patch! 
[i]Btw, 10% is the max amount Bit will be discounted this year.[/i]

The 1.3.0 release contains a new free autumn asset pack called "Orion" (containing 60 assets) and a new example animation using some of the new assets. The 1.3.0 version also takes care of a range of bugs. Moreover, it contains some stability improvements, font-size increase, and better scene editing. Also, time-lapses are now exported as videos!

We are looking into making video tutorials explaining how to create compositions and utilize the editor more, no time-frame yet.

[b]Please use the steam forum for feature requests, questions, or bug reports we actively monitor that.[/b]

We're also investigating C# support for the Godot game engine and an open-source importer.

Below you can find the patch notes containing added features, bug-fixes, and known issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38334836/b81133f1409c6c423a323e93a63f4a9b886aef80.png[/img]


[h2]Bit Animation Editor - 1.3.0 - Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]🌟Features[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New free asset pack pack "Orion"[/b]
60 new assets to play around with

[*][b]New example animation "Orion"[/b]
Larger, more advanced composition using some of the new assets.

[*][b]New palette "Orion".[/b]
See the palettes folder in the install folder for all available free palettes.

[*][b]Time-lapse exports to video instead of GIF[/b]
Time-lapses sometimes have a lot of frames resulting in really big GIFs which are hard to share. Video is a much better format for sharing these on social media.

[*][b]Increased UI font-size on both Windows and Mac[/b]
For better visibility.

[*][b]Added social media links to welcome window[/b]
all the links...

[*][b]Safer asset removal[/b]
Added a new confirmation window when pressing remove assets to prevent accidentally removing standard assets.

[*][b]Pixel-art Scaler[/b]
Changed the name of the scale configuration to pixel-art Scale and added tool-tip explaining that this is not a zoom feature and that it's designed to allow scaled art but with small positional transformations.

[*][b]Empty Scene States[/b]
Added new empty state for main scene with buttons to open or create a new project. This was added to detect save states and enforce new projects to be saved. This in turn prevents some bugs with asset replacement and palettes.

[*][b]Empty scene[/b]
Changed so the application doesn't start with a default empty window.

[*][b]Secrets[/b]
Prepared some ground work for procedural scene generation.
This is also why there is such strict library management. data data data.

[*][b]Export[/b]
Added an export tab under scene configuration.

[*][b]Close button[/b]
Added a close project button to the start menu when a project or example is open.[/list]

[h3]👾Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Loading size[/b]
Loading screen no longer cuts of progress description.

[*][b]Loading alignment[/b]
Loading screen text aligned to the left to avoid jumping.

[*][b]Pointer calculation[/b]
Recalculated the drag and drop pointer positions to match the hovered asset's bounding box on the screen. This will make it much more intuitive and simpler to drag and drop assets and help out with targeting an asset in a scene with a lot of entities.

[*][b]Scene entity pointer activation[/b]
Clicking and hovering outside of the design scene will no longer trigger large asset movement, hovering, and activation.

[*][b]Importer[/b]
Restricted the asset importer to PNG and JPEG/JPG as other formats could be imported but are not supported or evaluated.
[i]Let us know what format you would like to import, we are looking into supporting GIF frames.[/i]

[*][b]Palette buttons[/b]
Moved down the find color button from the palette tool to prevent it from getting cut off in the new re-sizable windows.

[*][b]Export files[/b]
Restricted the export file-ending types for GIF, MP4 and PNG to match the actual file-type to prevent strange export files.

[*][b]Asset buttons[/b]
Changed so that "add to scene" and "replace" is only visible if a saved project is opened.

[*][b]Importer window[/b]
Fixed a bug with the import window rendering off-screen preventing some users to import their own PNGs and JPEGs.

[*][b]Replace[/b]
Added a before save history state when replacing an asset.
[/list]

[h3]💣Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]History Performance[/b]
Slowdown performance with a large history state.

[*][b]Color replacement[/b]
Large projects with a lot of assets can crash when importing color palettes.

[*][b]Missing Animations[/b]
Removing library asset animations can crash projects.

[*][b]Clone issues?[/b]
Reports about cloning crashes, if you have an example of this please let us know how to reproduce.
[/list]

Thank you! ❤️
// Kim & Vendela

notes.title: Bit Animation Editor - v1.2.0 - Mac support, video exporter and more!
notes.content:
[b]🍏Mac & 🎞️ Video Export[/b]
Today we celebrate the new Mac support! We're also happy to finally support direct MP4 video export (which is super good for social media sharing)!

[b]📦 Asset packs[/b]
There have been a lot of requests for additional asset-packs with our sprites and art. We are happy to hear that you would like to use our Bits and will continue to release free asset-packs that can be used to compose animations. This patch includes new free asset-packs and examples from some of the art projects we made on our release stream on Steam last month.  

[b]📐 Zoom and Scaling[/b]
We added an editor zoom for larger canvases and a new welcome screen.
The scaling feature was never meant to be used as a zoom function, but for scaling of the art. However, now we got a proper zoom feature. On top of that, we added support for individual scaling of entities in the scene.

[b]🌟More[/b]
The patch contains lots of more changes. Below you can find the patch notes containing added features, bug-fixes, and known issues.

Here is a celebratory Mac release trailer.
[previewyoutube=rdAtzihDTL8;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38334836/0eb591b4163e57c0f2377199d9e3dd1fc89d9030.gif[/img]


[h2]Bit Animation Editor - 1.2.0 - Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]🌟Features[/h3]
[list][*][b]Mac OS support[/b]
You can now install the Mac OS version through Steam.

[/*][*][b]New video export[/b]
Export to MP4, select frames, frame-skip, and frame rate.
We are super excited about this feature as it saves a lot of time when sharing art. [/*][/list][list][*][b]New free assets-packs Owlo, Shogun, Rose & Mac[/b]
New assets added to the editor.

[/*][*][b]New editor zoom[/b]
A new zoom feature to scale the canvas while working.

[/*][*][b]New movable & re-sizable windows[/b]
You can now click on any window bar to move it. You can also resize the windows. 

[/*][*][b]New reset workspace option[/b]
Lets you reset the workspace to its original size and positions.
Let us know how you would like to configure this.

[/*][*][b]New examples menu[/b]
With basic examples and more advanced examples.

[/*][*][b]Reset animations on export[/b]
A new export option that is on per default to reset animations while exporting. [/*][/list][list][*][b]New basic example projects[/b]
Show some fundamental concepts that can be helpful when composing.

[/*][*][b]New advanced examples[/b]
Owlo, Shogun, Rose and a celebratory Mac one.[/*][/list][list][*][b]New loading screen[/b]
Optimized application loading performance and boot states.
This helps when having a large library.[/*][/list][list][*][b]New welcome screen[/b]
Containing simpler access to example projects, documentation, and forums.
Open welcome screen from help at anytime.[/*][/list][list][*][b]New Mac standalone export[/b]
Includes both the Windows and Mac files while exporting.
The mac binary can be run from command line with the same arguments as Windows exe.

[/*][*][b]New documentation menu[/b] 
With direct links to some of the basics of the tool.

[/*][*][b]New novel Steam achievements[/b]
To welcome Mac and for celebrating export.

[/*][*][b]Added support for example projects[/b]
Changing examples will prompt to save as new.

[/*][*][b]Reset tweens[/b]
Tweening animations are reset just like spritesheet animations on new asset addition as well as on export option.

[/*][*][b]Increased export frames[/b]
Increased max frames to export from 512 to 1024
Increase the length of exportable animations. 

[/*][*][b]New Individual scaling[/b]
Entities in the scene can now have its own scale.
Tweening animations support scaling.
Updated standalone renders to support individual scaling.

[/*][*][b]Updated Unity importer to support individual scaling.
[/b]Used for game development.[b]

[/b][/*][*][b]Major code refactoring to support multiple operative systems.[/b]
We could in theory now support Linux and iOS.

[/*][*][b]Added forum links to help[/b]
This is a good place to request features or ask questions. 

[/*][*][b]Minor performances fixes and improvements. 
[/b]General code optimizations. [/*][/list]
 
[h3]👾Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*][b]Resized and centered export window[/b]
To better fit on different screen resolutions.

[/*][*][b]Export screen[/b]
Fixed a bug where the Export screen displayed wrong information.

[/*][*][b]Export screen state bug[/b]
Fixed a bug where getting stuck in export while canceling the UI.

[/*][*][b]Simplified window title[/b]
Simplified main scene title to prevent bugs and performance issues.

[/*][*][b]Debugger[/b]
Removed some debug messages when running from terminal.

[/*][*][b]Color palette[/b]
Fixed a bug where the palette color finder couldn't find some hex colors in the scene.[/*][/list]

[h3]💣Known Issues[/h3]
[list][*][b]Large assets[/b]
Importing high-resolution assets will have performance implications, this tool was mainly built for pixelart. 

[/*][*][b]Bundle Zip[/b]
Sometimes Bundle Export leaves a couple of extra backup PNGs outside of the zip.

[/*][*][b]Mac renderer[/b]
The Mac standalone renderer will require chmod 777 to work on some Macs.

[/*][*][b]Unsaved Projects[/b]
There are still some states for new unsaved projects where replacing assets or applying palettes can reset the project. Make sure to save!

[/*][*][b]Mac Security[/b]
Bit is not signed with an Apple developer certificate yet, if you have problem booting you might need to manually allow the application in Security & Privacy. [url=https://support.apple.com/en-gb/guide/mac-help/mh40616/mac]https://support.apple.com/en-gb/guide/mac-help/mh40616/mac[/url]

[/*][*][b]Mac Legacy OS versions[/b]
OSX below Catalina is untested. 

[/*][*][b]Tutorial request[/b]
There have been some requests for more tutorials like videos, gifs or in-app explanations in addition to the documentation, let us know what kind of tutorials that would help you![/*][/list]
 

Thank you! ❤️
Share your creative ideas for the tool

notes.title: Bit Animation Editor - New patch - v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you for such a great launch![/h2]
We are so happy to have reached the first milestone and get this tool out for artists. 
We made a small patch today fixing some interesting bugs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38334836/6fce20082614ae74fb8528f821a736385931c244.gif[/img]
[i]OwlO was created live on the launch stream. [/i]

There have been a lot of questions about mac and we do have an alpha build for mac but being a tiny team we focus on one platform at a time. We have some planned upcoming features, export targets and ideas we want to implement in the close future. 

Let us know what you would like to see more off, or things that would help you use the tool better.

[h2]Bit Animation Editor - 1.1.0 - Patch Notes [/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Asset tile-size calculation bug[/b]
	In some rare scenarios imported sprite could miss initial size calculations.
	Added a check to recalculate missing sizes when assets are loaded. 

[*][b]Project Resizing Bug[/b]
	Switching between projects would not set the scene to the project size but to the default size.

[*][b]Project Name input focus[/b]
	Fixed so that the project name input-field doesn't lose focus while typing.

[*][b]Preview Scale[/b]
	Preview window now scales with project size to make it clearer how much space an asset 
	will take in the scene.

[*][b]Added JPG Support[/b]
	it's not recommended to import large jpg's into the editor.
	[url=https://cdn.morgondag.io/bit/cat.gif]Please don't create large cat gif's like this one,[/url] 
	the exporter is single-threaded with an in-memory frame-buffer (the app will cry).
[/list]
Thank you
👩‍🎨👨‍🎨
[b]Morgondag[/b]
